MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength); leadership is Broad (Top 5 across 4 sectors). Mixed sector returns and major 1W/1M divergences argue for restraint rather than a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads on 1W returns (+3.27%), with TTWO in RECOVERY (1W: +7.96% | 1M: -2.83%). Real Estate is next (+2.70%); Consumer Discretionary is third (+2.59%), with AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +1.71%) and LOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +25.58%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest (-7.26% 1W; -5.59% 1M), with XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -2.49%). Technology also lags (-1.00% 1W; -10.90% 1M), with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%); Utilities slipped 0.22% this week despite a positive 1M return.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +19.34%), AMD RECOVERY (1W: +8.94% | 1M: -16.37%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +1.71%), and EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +15.41%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented), though AMD’s weekly rebound diverges from its monthly trend.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC BELOW TREND (1W: -9.41% | 1M: -14.32%), NUE BELOW TREND (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -0.44%), DOW CORRECTION (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +8.94%), and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%); the fifth-weakest is PSX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -9.04%). Weakness clusters in Energy and Materials, with Technology also pressured.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +19.34%), and AMD RECOVERY (1W: +8.94% | 1M: -16.37%). Major divergence is present across several large stocks, including AMD and GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -18.06%); treat rebounds as tactical, not confirmed trend changes.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak overall (-1.00% 1W; -10.90% 1M), with mixed individual action: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +1.89%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.17%), and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%). AMD is in RECOVERY (1W: +8.94% | 1M: -16.37%); sector stock-level breadth was not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials posted modest gains (+0.21% 1W; +3.70% 1M), with JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +2.73%). V is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +9.52%) and MA is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +11.32%), so leadership is mixed rather than broad; stock-level sector breadth was not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is positive (+1.30% 1W; +9.39% 1M), with JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.27% | 1M: +7.91%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +19.73%). UNH is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +4.83%); stock-level sector breadth was not provided.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure across the broad leaders, including NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +1.71%), while monitoring risk in NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major timeframe divergences favor measured positioning over a strong style tilt.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%) and DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +19.34%) for continuation, conditional on holding weekly gains; AMD RECOVERY (1W: +8.94% | 1M: -16.37%) needs follow-through to confirm a turn. BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%) and XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -2.49%) remain at risk if weakness persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+3.27% 1W) and Consumer Discretionary (+2.59% 1W), within overall breadth of 8/11 positive sectors; monitor for continued participation. BEARISH: Energy (-7.26% 1W; -5.59% 1M) and Technology (-1.00% 1W; -10.90% 1M) remain weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not supplied, so monitor trend triggers instead: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%) needs a sustained weekly recovery, while AMD RECOVERY (1W: +8.94% | 1M: -16.37%) needs monthly-trend improvement. NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%) and DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +19.34%) need to hold their weekly gains.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TTWO (+78): CEO raised expectations for GTA VI preorders; price is in RECOVERY (1W: +7.96% | 1M: -2.83%), so confirmation is pending. CAT (+65): a large generator order lifted sentiment, but price remains BELOW TREND (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -25.01%), a notable sentiment-price divergence; JNJ (+50): trial wins align with price strength, ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.27% | 1M: +7.91%).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-75): reports of a board investigation coincide with price weakness, BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%). BA (-45): workforce cuts amid production struggles confirm weakness, BELOW TREND (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -9.45%); AAPL (-35): delayed AI timelines diverge from price strength, ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.17%).

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; breadth is 8/11 sectors positive, leadership is broad, and style is mixed with no clear leadership. NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +6.21%) and MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +1.89%) show relative strength. Monitor the major trend divergences and NVDA’s negative sentiment alongside its decline, BELOW TREND (1W: -11.58% | 1M: -22.07%).
